summary: Implement S1 static checker for wellmanifest/python distribution parity

delivery.outcome: Promote wellmanifest/python from S0 reference-only to S1 local-conformance with a dependency-free static checker enforcing PYTHON-DIST-001 (version and wheel content byte parity), PYTHON-DIST-002 (CLI entry-point and --version contract), and PYTHON-DIST-003 (wheel archive safety and source module completeness).
nonGoals: Executing repository Python code or building wheels during conformance checks
Claiming S3/S4/S5 runtime authority for local-conformance packs

architecture.decision: Implement a read-only, bounded static checker in src/wellman/python_pack_checker.py using stdlib tomllib/ast/zipfile and wire wellmanifest/python into ConformanceRunner and STANDARDS_CATALOG at S1 local-conformance.

validation.evidence: Positive and negative tests verify PYTHON-DIST-001, PYTHON-DIST-002, and PYTHON-DIST-003 findings, symlink/zip-bomb safety bounds, and zero remaining S0 standards in STANDARDS_CATALOG.
Governance gate and Wellman standards check pass with zero errors.
